comparison.objective: Isolate and vent a pressurized filter housing before opening it, rather than commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Valve/control operation and cover opening after pressure verification versus fine hex-tool use, collar tuning, and physical test cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Inlet closed, pressure indication extinguished, then safe cover opening and cartridge disposal versus bounded repeated axial stopping.
comparison.reason: Both enforce lockout-style sequencing, but shared safety sequencing alone does not establish overlap. The physical mechanisms and validated end states are different; no spec versions or numeric vent thresholds are supplied.
